Name: Napalm Rocks
Author: EinZeR24
Description:
[quote][size=4][b]During development I occasionally consulted AI tools when the mod wasn’t behaving as expected and no errors showed up in the log.
If you strongly oppose any AI involvement, this mod may not be for you.[/b][/size][/quote]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Extract the .rar file, you can just copy the folder into where you store your Stardew Valley files (X:\YYY\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)[/color]



[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][/url]- Button to toggle whether you want the mod to take effect only on Mine/Skull Cavern. (Toggle off means you can apply the effect everywhere, not just Mine/Skull Cavern.)
- Button to toggle whether you want the mod to take effect on the Volcano Dungeon as well. (Toggle off means it'll not applied, but if you also have the Mine/Skull Cavern button toggle off, it'll revert the effect).
-  Button to toggle if you have to use Napalm Ring or not for the mod to take effect. (Toggle off means you don't have to use Napalm Ring.)
- Slider for Explosion Radius. (Default 2, max 6)
- Button to toggle if the explosion caused from Napalm can harm your character. (Default off.)
- Button to toggle if you want the exploding rocks give you Combat EXP. (Default off.)
- Slider for how much EXP you'll gain.
- Button to toggle if you want the explosion cause chain reactions. (No means you'll not get the chained reactions, which is the entire point of this mod.)
- Verbose logging (ignore this)
- Buttons to toggle if you want Nodes, Forages, and/or other breakables to explode from this effect as well. (Default off.)

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GCMC[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3214]Wear More Rings[/url] (the one that causes one of my problems when playtesting), and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7787]Better Bombs[/url]. In fact, if you're uncomfortable with the flashing lights from explosion (and trust me, it'll be a lot), do use that mods. Better Bombs also going to affect some of the explosion properties of this mods. Also, Better Bombs has the toggle to disable flash if you really need that, or if you don't want to download that mod, you can just tell me to add the option, and I (maybe) will add that feature, dunno, don't expect too much from me. 

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]

Manifest.Name: Napalm Rocks
Manifest.Description: While wearing the Napalm Ring in the Mines, Skull Cavern or Volcano Dungeon, destroying rocks (and optionally nodes/forages) counts as defeating an enemy and causes them to explode. Supports GMCM and Wear More Rings.
Manifest.Author: EinZeR
